## Jobs

Get, list, rename and download the results of any job, and follow its progress.

| Operation | HTTP | Python | TypeScript | C# |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| List jobs | `GET /v1/jobs/` | `client.jobs.list()` | `client.jobs.list()` | `client.Jobs.ListAsync()` |
| Get job | `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/` | `client.jobs.get()` | `client.jobs.get()` | `client.Jobs.GetAsync()` |
| Update job nickname | `PATCH /v1/jobs/{id}/` | `client.jobs.update_nickname()` | `client.jobs.updateNickname()` | `client.Jobs.UpdateNicknameAsync()` |
| Download job input file | `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/input-file/` | `client.jobs.download_input_file()` | `client.jobs.downloadInputFile()` | `client.Jobs.DownloadInputFileAsync()` |
| Download job result | `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/result/` | `client.jobs.download_result()` | `client.jobs.downloadResult()` | `client.Jobs.DownloadResultAsync()` |
| Get job processing status with progress | `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/status/` | `client.jobs.get_status()` | `client.jobs.getStatus()` | `client.Jobs.GetStatusAsync()` |
